description: Unofficial Uryu Ishida fan-art companion inspired by Bleach, with original toy-needle sewing, cloth display, gentle blue-paper ornament and jogging animations. The early white Quincy tunic, short capelet and blue trim are simplified with full trousers and closed shoes. Sewing tools are rounded toys and are stowed for movement; no arrows or attacks. This independent desktop adaptation is not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
